source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 10 (PDF 218-233), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 10 (Human Respiratory System) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 The uptake of oxygen from the environment and disposal of carbon dioxide into it at the body system level is called:
(Body system ki satah par mahol se oxygen lene aur carbon dioxide nikalne ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: External respiration body system ki satah par O₂ lena aur CO₂ nikalna hai; is mein saans aur capillaries mein gas tabadla shamil hai.

book_ref.quote: The term external respiration is used for the uptake of oxygen from the environment

blocks.prompt:
2 The main organs of the respiratory system, providing a suitable respiratory surface, are the:
(Respiratory system ke asal organs jo munasib respiratory surface dete hain:)
blocks.explanation: Lungs (phephre) asal organs hain jo gas tabadle ke liye munasib surface dete hain.

book_ref.quote: The main organs of respiratory systems are the lungs

blocks.prompt:
3 Gas exchange at the respiratory surface takes place by:
(Respiratory surface par gas ka tabadla kis amal se hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Respiratory surface par gas tabadla diffusion (phailao) se hota hai.

book_ref.quote: This gaseous exchange occurs through diffusion

blocks.prompt:
4 The respiratory surface is thin so that:
(Respiratory surface patli kyun hoti hai?)

options.text: gases kam se kam faasla tay karein
hawa paani ke bukharat se bhar jaye

blocks.explanation: Yeh patli hai taa ke gases ko kam se kam faasla tay karna pare.

book_ref.quote: It is thin – so that gases have to travel minimum distance

blocks.prompt:
5 The respiratory surface is located internally so that:
(Respiratory surface jism ke andar kyun hoti hai?)

options.text: is ki geeli satah hawa ko pani na khoye

blocks.explanation: Andar hone se is ki geeli satah hawa ko pani nahi khoti.

book_ref.quote: It is located internally – so that its moist surface does not lose water to the atmosphere

blocks.prompt:
6 Which property keeps the respiratory surface open so that it does not collapse?
(Kaun si khususiyat respiratory surface ko khula rakhti hai taa ke yeh pichke nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Structural support (sahara) ise khula rakhta aur pichakne se bachata hai.

book_ref.quote: It has structural support– so that it remains open and does not collapse

blocks.prompt:
7 Air reaches the respiratory surface after passing a branched tubular way so that:
(Hawa shakhdar nalyon se guzar kar respiratory surface tak kyun pahunchti hai?)

options.text: woh paani ke bukharat se bhar jaye
us mein carbon dioxide mil jaye

blocks.explanation: Shakhdar nalyon se guzar kar hawa surface tak pahunchne se pehle paani ke bukharat se bhar jati hai.

book_ref.quote: so that air becomes saturated with water vapour before reaching it

blocks.prompt:
8 The continuous system of passages through which air flows into and out of the body is the:
(Raston ka woh musalsal nizam jis se hawa jism mein aati jati hai:)
blocks.explanation: Yeh organs raston ka musalsal nizam banate hain jise respiratory tract kehte hain; is ke upper aur lower hisse hain.

book_ref.quote: The organs of the respiratory system form a continuous system of passages, called the respiratory tract

blocks.prompt:
9 The upper respiratory tract consists of:
(Upper respiratory tract kin organs par mushtamil hai?)
blocks.explanation: Upper respiratory tract nasal cavity, pharynx aur larynx par mushtamil hai; in mein gas tabadla nahi hota.

book_ref.quote: It consists of nasal cavity, pharynx and larynx

blocks.prompt:
10 Which statement about the organs of the upper respiratory tract is correct?
(Upper respiratory tract ke organs ke baare mein kaun sa bayan sahi hai?)

options.text: Zyada tar gas tabadla in mein hota hai
Yeh hawa ko saaf, nam aur garam karte hain magar in mein gas tabadla nahi hota

blocks.explanation: Yeh hawa ko guzarte, saaf, nam aur garam karte hain; in mein gas tabadla nahi hota.

book_ref.quote: No gas exchange occurs in these organs

blocks.prompt:
11 The nasal cavity is partitioned by the:
(Nasal cavity ko kaun taqseem karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nasal cavity naak ke peechhe hawa bhari bari jagah hai jise nasal septum do hisson mein baant-ta hai.

book_ref.quote: partitioned by a nasal septum

blocks.prompt:
12 Besides its respiratory functions, the nasal cavity contains chemoreceptors for:
(Respiratory kaamon ke ilawa nasal cavity mein chemoreceptors kis liye hain?)

options.text: soonghne ki hiss aur zaiqe mein hissa

blocks.explanation: Nasal cavity mein soonghne ke liye chemoreceptors hain jo zaiqe mein bhi hissa dalte hain.

book_ref.quote: the nasal cavity also contains chemoreceptors needed for sense of smell

blocks.prompt:
13 Which part is common to both the respiratory and the digestive systems?
(Kaun sa hissa respiratory aur digestive dono systems mein mushtarik hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hawa aur khurak dono pharynx se guzarte hain, is liye yeh dono systems ka hissa hai.

book_ref.quote: Both air and food pass through it

blocks.prompt:
14 The larynx is called the voice box because it contains:
(Larynx ko voice box kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Larynx mein do bands, vocal cords, hain jo hawa guzarne par thartharate aur awaz paida karte hain.

book_ref.quote: It is also called the voice box, because it contains two bands

blocks.prompt:
15 The opening of the larynx is called:
(Larynx ke munh ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Larynx ka munh glottis hai; epiglottis is ke oopar aur aage cartilage ka dhakkan hai.

book_ref.quote: Epiglottis is a cartilaginous flap that extends in front and above the opening of larynx called glottis

blocks.prompt:
16 During swallowing, the glottis is closed by:
(Nigalte waqt glottis ko kaun band karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zuban ki peechhe ki harkat larynx ko oopar uthati hai aur epiglottis neeche ho kar glottis band kar deti hai.

book_ref.quote: Due to it, the epiglottis is forced downwards to close the glottis

blocks.prompt:
17 If swallowed material starts to enter the larynx, it is usually expelled by:
(Agar nigla hua maadda larynx mein jane lage to aam tor par kaise bahar nikalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh larynx ko chherta hai aur taqatwar khansi ka reflex use gale mein wapas nikal deta hai.

book_ref.quote: it irritates the larynx and stimulates a strong cough reflex

blocks.prompt:
18 Muscles of the larynx that move the vocal cords together also control:
(Larynx ke woh muscles jo vocal cords ko qareeb late hain aur kya control karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Vocal cords ko door karne wale muscles saans dete hain; qareeb karne wale awaz banate aur us ki pitch aur volume control karte hain.

book_ref.quote: The latter muscles also control the pitch of sounds and help control their volume

blocks.prompt:
19 The total length of airways conducting air through the human respiratory tract is about:
(Insani respiratory tract mein hawa le jane wale raston ki kul lambai taqreeban kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Respiratory tract mein hawa ke raston ki lambai hairan-kun 2,414 kilometre hai.

book_ref.quote: There are an astonishing 2,414 kilometres of airways

blocks.prompt:
20 The widest passageway of the respiratory tract is the:
(Respiratory tract ka sab se chaura rasta kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Trachea (saans ki nali) sab se chaura rasta hai; yeh taqreeban 1 inch chauri aur 4-6 inch lambi hai.

book_ref.quote: It is the widest passageway in the respiratory tract

blocks.prompt:
21 The human trachea is about:
(Insani trachea taqreeban kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Trachea taqreeban 1 inch chauri aur 4–6 inch lambi hai.

book_ref.quote: It is about 1 inch wide and 4–6 inches long

blocks.prompt:
22 The C-shaped rings of cartilage in the trachea:
(Trachea mein C-shaped cartilage rings ka kaam:)

options.text: taqat aur sahara de kar raste ko khula rakhti hain
nigalte waqt glottis band karti hain

blocks.explanation: C-shaped cartilage taqat aur sahara deti hai taa ke rasta khula rahe.

book_ref.quote: The C-shaped cartilage provides strength and support to the trachea to keep the passage open

blocks.prompt:
23 In the trachea, the cilia push foreign particles trapped in mucus towards the:
(Trachea mein cilia mucus mein phanse zarraat ko kis taraf dhakelte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Cilia phanse zarraat ko pharynx ki taraf dhakelte hain.

book_ref.quote: The cilia propel foreign particles trapped in the mucus toward the pharynx

blocks.prompt:
24 How many secondary bronchi are there in the right lung?
(Daayen lung mein kitne secondary bronchi hain?)
blocks.explanation: Baayen lung mein do aur daayen lung mein teen secondary bronchi hain.

book_ref.quote: There are two secondary bronchi in left lung while three in right lung

blocks.prompt:
25 In the secondary bronchi, C-shaped cartilages are replaced by:
(Secondary bronchi mein C-shaped cartilages ki jagah kya hota hai?)

options.text: kuch nahi; cartilage hota hi nahi

blocks.explanation: Secondary bronchi mein C-shaped cartilages ki jagah cartilage plates hoti hain; bronchioles mein cartilage plates nahi hotin.

book_ref.quote: In secondary bronchi, the C-shaped cartilages are replaced with cartilage plates

blocks.prompt:
26 Which air passages have no cartilage plates?
(Kin hawai raston mein cartilage plates nahi hotin?)
blocks.explanation: Bronchioles mein cartilage plates nahi hotin.

book_ref.quote: The bronchioles do not have cartilage plates

blocks.prompt:
27 The terminal bronchioles end in:
(Terminal bronchioles kis mein khatam hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Terminal bronchioles alveolar ducts mein khatam hote hain jo alveoli ke guchhon par khatam hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: The terminal bronchioles end in alveolar ducts

blocks.prompt:
28 The membrane that lines the lungs is the:
(Lungs ko dhaanpne wali membrane kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Visceral pleura lungs par hoti hai; parietal pleura thoracic cavity ki andaruni deewar par.

book_ref.quote: First membrane, visceral pleura, lines the lungs

blocks.prompt:
29 The fluid in the pleural cavity:
(Pleural cavity ka fluid kya karta hai?)

options.text: lungs ko aazadi se phailne aur sukarne deta hai

blocks.explanation: Do membranes ke darmiyan pleural cavity ka fluid lungs ko aazadi se phailne aur sukarne deta hai.

book_ref.quote: This fluid allows the lungs to expand and contract freely during breathing

blocks.prompt:
30 Which statement about the lungs is correct?
(Lungs ke baare mein kaun sa bayan sahi hai?)

options.text: Baayan lung bara hai aur us ke teen lobes hain
Dono lungs ke do lobes hain
Daayan lung bara hai aur us ke teen lobes hain
Daayan lung chhota hai aur us ke do lobes hain

blocks.explanation: Daayan lung bara aur teen lobes wala hai; chhota baayan lung do lobes wala hai aur dil ke liye jagah chhorta hai.

book_ref.quote: The right lung is larger and contains three lobes

blocks.prompt:
31 The left lung is smaller than the right because:
(Baayan lung daayen se chhota kyun hai?)

options.text: yeh dil ke liye jagah chhorta hai

blocks.explanation: Chhota baayan lung dil ke liye jagah chhorta hai jo seene ke darmiyan se zara baayen hai.

book_ref.quote: The smaller left lung allows room for the heart

blocks.prompt:
32 Each cluster at the end of an alveolar duct contains about:
(Alveolar duct ke sire par har guchhe mein taqreeban kitne alveoli hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Har guchhe mein 20-30 alveoli hote hain aur yeh khoon ki capillaries se ghire hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Each cluster contains 20-30 alveoli

blocks.prompt:
33 The moist epithelial wall of an alveolus is about:
(Alveolus ki geeli epithelial deewar taqreeban kitni moti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alveolus sirf 0.1 micrometre moti geeli epithelial tissue se bana hai.

book_ref.quote: An alveolus is made of moist epithelial tissue (only 0.1 micrometre thick)

blocks.prompt:
34 The liquid secreted by some alveolar cells that prevents the alveoli from collapsing and sticking together is:
(Alveoli ke kuch cells ka woh maaye jo alveoli ko pichakne aur chipakne se rokta hai:)
blocks.explanation: Surfactant alveoli ke andar hota hai aur hawa nikalne par unhein pichakne se rokta hai; yeh musalsal banta aur jazb hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Some epithelial cells of alveoli secrete a liquid called surfactant

blocks.prompt:
35 The two lungs may contain as many as:
(Dono lungs mein taqreeban kitne alveoli ho sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Dono lungs mein 700 million tak alveoli ho sakte hain jo bohat bari satah dete hain.

book_ref.quote: The two lungs may contain as many as 700 million alveoli

blocks.prompt:
36 Oxygenated blood is carried from the lungs back to the heart by the:
(Lungs se oxygen wala khoon wapas dil tak kaun le jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pulmonary arteries oxygen ke baghair khoon lungs tak late hain; pulmonary veins oxygen wala khoon dil ko wapas le jati hain.

book_ref.quote: pulmonary veins carry the oxygenated blood back to the heart

blocks.prompt:
37 The movement of air in and out of the body is called:
(Jism mein hawa ke aane jane ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Jism mein hawa ka aana jana breathing ya ventilation kehlata hai.

book_ref.quote: The movement of the air in and out of the body is called breathing or ventilation

blocks.prompt:
38 Air moves into and out of the lungs because:
(Hawa lungs mein aati jati kyun hai?)

options.text: lungs khud hawa khenchte aur dhakelte hain
alveoli sukarte aur dheele hote hain
muscles lungs mein manfi aur musbat pressure banate hain

blocks.explanation: Lungs khud hawa nahi khenchte ya dhakelte; diaphragm aur intercostal muscles pressure kam zyada karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Rather, it is done by creating negative and positive pressures in the lungs

blocks.prompt:
39 The intercostal muscles are present:
(Intercostal muscles kahan hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Intercostal muscles har do pasliyon ke darmiyan hain; diaphragm thoracic cavity aur pait ko alag karta hai.

book_ref.quote: the intercostal muscles (present between each pair of ribs)

blocks.prompt:
40 During inspiration the lungs expand with the thorax because of:
(Inspiration ke dauran lungs thorax ke saath kyun phailte hain?)

options.text: visceral aur parietal pleural membranes ka chipka hona

blocks.explanation: Thorax mein jagah barhti hai aur visceral aur parietal pleura ke chipke hone se lungs phailte hain.

book_ref.quote: As a result, lungs expand because of the adherence of the visceral and parietal pleural membranes

blocks.prompt:
41 During expiration, the elastic tension of the thorax and lungs is relieved by:
(Expiration mein thorax aur lungs ka elastic tanao kaise khatam hota hai?)

options.text: intercostal muscles aur diaphragm ka dheela hona

blocks.explanation: In muscles ke dheele hone se tanao khatam hota hai; diaphragm gumbad numa aur pasliyon ka pinjra andar aata hai.

book_ref.quote: This elastic tension is relieved by the relaxation of the intercostal muscles and diaphragm

blocks.prompt:
42 Each breath is initiated by neurons of the respiratory centre located in the:
(Har saans respiratory centre ke neurons shuru karte hain jo kahan hai?)
blocks.explanation: Respiratory centre medulla oblongata mein hai jo brain stem ka hissa hai.

book_ref.quote: Each breath is initiated by neurons in a respiratory centre located in the medulla oblongata

blocks.prompt:
43 Expiration occurs when the neurons of the respiratory centre:
(Expiration tab hoti hai jab respiratory centre ke neurons:)

options.text: impulses dena band kar dete hain

blocks.explanation: Jab yeh neurons impulses dena band karte hain to muscles dheele hote hain aur expiration hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: When these neurons stop producing impulses, the diaphragm and intercostal muscles relax and expiration occurs

blocks.prompt:
44 It is harder to breathe at high altitudes because:
(Oonchai par saans lena mushkil kyun hai?)

options.text: fazai pressure kam hai, is liye thorax ko zyada phailna parta hai

blocks.explanation: Kam fazai pressure ki wajah se lungs ka pressure us se kam karne ke liye thorax ko zyada phailna parta hai.

book_ref.quote: That is why it is harder to breathe at high altitudes

blocks.prompt:
45 In birds, inhaled air from outside first flows to the:
(Parindon mein bahar se aane wali hawa sab se pehle kahan jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hawa aik hi rukh mein behti hai: bahar → posterior air sacs → lungs → anterior air sacs → bahar.

book_ref.quote: Air flows in one direction. It flows from outside to posterior air sacs

blocks.prompt:
46 Gas transport in the body means carrying:
(Jism mein gas transport ka matlab hai:)

options.text: oxygen lungs se tissues tak aur CO₂ tissues se lungs tak le jana

blocks.explanation: Oxygen lungs se tissues tak aur saath hi CO₂ tissues se lungs tak jati hai.

book_ref.quote: Oxygen is transported from lungs to all tissues and, at the same time, carbon dioxide is transported from tissue to the lungs

blocks.prompt:
47 Blood plasma can dissolve a maximum of only about:
(Blood plasma zyada se zyada taqreeban kitni oxygen hal kar sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Plasma sirf taqreeban 3 mL O₂ fi litre hal karta hai jab ke poora khoon taqreeban 200 mL O₂ fi litre le jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Blood plasma can dissolve a maximum of only about 3 mL O₂ per litre

blocks.prompt:
48 Whole blood carries far more oxygen than plasma can dissolve because most oxygen is:
(Poora khoon plasma ki hal karne ki had se kahin zyada oxygen kyun le jata hai?)

options.text: RBCs ke andar haemoglobin se jurri hoti hai

blocks.explanation: Zyada tar oxygen plasma mein hal nahi balke RBCs ke haemoglobin se jurri hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Yet whole blood carries almost 200 mL O₂ per litre

blocks.prompt:
49 At sea level, the partial pressure of oxygen in the alveoli is approximately:
(Samandar ki satah par alveoli mein oxygen ka partial pressure taqreeban kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Samandar ki satah par alveoli ka PO₂ taqreeban 105 mm Hg hai, is liye taqreeban 97% haemoglobin oxyhaemoglobin ban jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The partial pressure of oxygen in alveoli (at sea level) is approximately 105 mm Hg

blocks.prompt:
50 In blood leaving the lungs, about what percentage of haemoglobin is oxyhaemoglobin?
(Lungs se nikalne wale khoon mein taqreeban kitne feesad haemoglobin oxyhaemoglobin hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alveolar PO₂ (105 mm Hg) par taqreeban 97% haemoglobin oxygen se milta hai.

book_ref.quote: So, about 97% of the haemoglobin within RBCs combines with oxygen and becomes oxyhaemoglobin

blocks.prompt:
51 The colour of deoxyhaemoglobin is:
(Deoxyhaemoglobin ka rang kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Oxyhaemoglobin chamakdar surkh aur deoxyhaemoglobin gehra surkh hai, magar deoxyhaemoglobin tissues ko neelahat deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Oxyhaemoglobin is bright red while deoxyhaemoglobin is dark red

blocks.prompt:
52 At rest, the partial pressure of oxygen in venous blood leaving the tissues is about:
(Aaram ki halat mein tissues se nikalne wale venous khoon mein oxygen ka partial pressure taqreeban kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tissues se veins mein jane wale khoon ka PO₂ 40 mm Hg hai aur saturation 75%.

book_ref.quote: it has a low partial pressure of oxygen (40 mm Hg)

blocks.prompt:
53 At rest, what percentage of oxyhaemoglobin releases its oxygen to the tissues?
(Aaram ki halat mein kitne feesad oxyhaemoglobin apni oxygen tissues ko deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: 97% − 75% = 22% oxyhaemoglobin aaram mein oxygen deta hai; 75% reserve rehta hai (kitab ki correction: 78% nahi).

book_ref.quote: It means that 22% (97% minus 75%) of the oxyhaemoglobin has released its oxygen to the tissues

blocks.prompt:
54 At rest, the oxygen reserve left in venous blood as oxyhaemoglobin is:
(Aaram ki halat mein venous khoon mein oxyhaemoglobin ki shakal mein kitni oxygen reserve rehti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kitab ke apne adad se aaram mein venous khoon mein 75% haemoglobin abhi oxyhaemoglobin hai (chhapa hua 78% ghalat hai).

book_ref.quote: so the reserve left in the blood is 75%, not 78%

blocks.prompt:
55 During exercise, the venous partial pressure of oxygen falls to about:
(Warzish ke dauran venous khoon mein oxygen ka partial pressure taqreeban kitna reh jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Warzish mein muscles zyada oxygen lete hain, venous PO₂ 20 mm Hg aur saturation 75% se 35% ho jati hai.

book_ref.quote: It decreases the venous blood partial pressure of oxygen to 20 mm Hg

blocks.prompt:
56 During exercise, the amount of oxygen unloaded from oxyhaemoglobin is:
(Warzish ke dauran oxyhaemoglobin se kitni oxygen utarti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Warzish mein 97% − 35% = 62% oxygen utarti hai, aaram ke 22% ki bajaye.

book_ref.quote: the amount of oxygen unloaded is now 62% (97% minus 35%), instead of the 22% at rest

blocks.prompt:
57 The oxygen reserve in blood can maintain life, if breathing is interrupted or the heart stops, for about:
(Agar saans ruk jaye ya dil band ho jaye to khoon ki oxygen reserve taqreeban kitni der zindagi qaim rakh sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Reserve itni oxygen rakhti hai ke chaar se paanch minute zindagi qaim rahe.

book_ref.quote: maintain life for four to five minutes if breathing is interrupted

blocks.prompt:
58 The effect of pH on haemoglobin's affinity for oxygen is called the:
(Haemoglobin ki oxygen se raghbat par pH ke asar ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: CO₂ khoon ka pH kam karti hai jis se haemoglobin ki oxygen se raghbat kam ho kar oxygen aasani se chhoot-ti hai: Bohr effect.

book_ref.quote: The effect of pH on haemoglobin’s affinity for oxygen is known as the Bohr effect

blocks.prompt:
59 An increase in temperature, as in exercising muscles, makes haemoglobin:
(Temperature barhne se (jaise warzish karte muscles mein) haemoglobin kya karta hai?)

options.text: oxygen ko zyada mazbooti se pakarta hai
carbon dioxide le jana band kar deta hai

blocks.explanation: Temperature barhna, kam pH ki tarah, raghbat kam karta hai; haemoglobin zyada oxygen chhorta hai.

book_ref.quote: Increasing temperature has a similar effect on haemoglobin’s affinity for oxygen

blocks.prompt:
60 CO₂ enters the blood from the tissues because:
(CO₂ tissues se khoon mein kyun aati hai?)

options.text: khoon mein is ka partial pressure zyada hai
tissues mein is ka partial pressure khoon se zyada hai
plasma ise active tor par jazb karta hai

blocks.explanation: Tissues mein PCO₂ khoon se zyada hai; lungs mein ulta, alveoli mein PCO₂ khoon se kam hai.

book_ref.quote: The partial pressure of CO₂ is higher in tissues than in blood

blocks.prompt:
61 In RBCs, CO₂ combines with water to form carbonic acid in the presence of the enzyme:
(RBCs mein CO₂ pani se mil kar carbonic acid kis enzyme ki maujoodgi mein banati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Carbonic anhydrase ki maujoodgi mein CO₂ + H₂O → H₂CO₃; H₂CO₃ H⁺ aur HCO₃⁻ mein toot-ta hai.

book_ref.quote: in the presence of enzyme carbonic anhydrase

blocks.prompt:
62 About what percentage of CO₂ is carried in the blood as bicarbonate ions?
(Taqreeban kitne feesad CO₂ khoon mein bicarbonate ions ki shakal mein jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Taqreeban 72% bicarbonate, 20% globin se jurri, aur 8% plasma mein hal.

book_ref.quote: Approximately 72% of carbon dioxide is carried in the blood as bicarbonate ions

blocks.prompt:
63 The exchange of a chloride ion for a bicarbonate ion across the RBC membrane is called:
(RBC membrane ke paar bicarbonate ion ke badle chloride ion ka tabadla kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aik transporter aik Cl⁻ ko aik HCO₃⁻ se badalta hai: chloride shift ya Hamburger phenomenon.

book_ref.quote: this is called the “chloride shift” or “Hamburger phenomenon”

blocks.prompt:
64 The major buffer of the blood plasma is:
(Blood plasma ka sab se bara buffer kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bicarbonate plasma ka bara buffer hai, is liye carbonic acid ka banna acid-base tawazun qaim rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: because bicarbonate serves as the major buffer of the blood plasma

blocks.prompt:
65 CO₂ joined to the globin chains of haemoglobin is correctly called:
(Haemoglobin ki globin chains se jurri CO₂ ka sahi naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh carbaminohaemoglobin hai (taqreeban 20% CO₂); carboxyhaemoglobin carbon monoxide wala haemoglobin hai (kitab ki correction).

book_ref.quote: CO₂ joined to the globin (protein) chains of haemoglobin is called carbaminohaemoglobin

blocks.prompt:
66 CO₂ and O₂ do not compete for attachment to haemoglobin because:
(CO₂ aur O₂ haemoglobin se judne ke liye muqabla kyun nahi karte?)

options.text: dono haem iron se judti hain
CO₂ protein hisse se aur O₂ haem iron se judti hai
CO₂ sirf plasma mein jati hai
O₂ sirf myoglobin se judti hai

blocks.explanation: CO₂ globin (protein) se aur O₂ haem iron se judti hai, is liye muqabla nahi.

book_ref.quote: CO₂ binds to the protein portion of haemoglobin while O₂ binds to the haem irons

blocks.prompt:
67 About what percentage of CO₂ is carried dissolved in the plasma?
(Taqreeban kitne feesad CO₂ plasma mein hal ho kar jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Thori CO₂ plasma ke pani mein hal hoti hai: taqreeban 8%.

book_ref.quote: About 8% of CO₂ is carried this way

blocks.prompt:
68 In the lungs, carbonic acid is converted back into H₂O and CO₂ because:
(Lungs mein carbonic acid wapas H₂O aur CO₂ kyun banta hai?)

options.text: alveoli ki hawa ka PCO₂ kam hai

blocks.explanation: Alveoli mein kam PCO₂ H₂CO₃ ko H₂O aur CO₂ banata hai jo alveoli mein diffuse ho jati hai.
